task.title: Trace key resolution flow and processing boundaries for pop-up insertion
task.shortdesc: Identify where key resolution occurs in the build pipeline and where pop-up insertion can be skipped or lost.

step.cmd: Identify the exact output path where pop-ups should appear (editor preview, HTML5 output, PDF, or a custom transform).
Run a build with verbose logging enabled and capture messages related to key resolution and map processing.
Confirm that the build resolves keys before the transform stage that generates keyword pop-ups (or related link/hover UI).
Check whether the topic is processed standalone (topic build) versus map-based processing, and switch to map-based processing if needed.
Inspect intermediate files (preprocessed DITA or temp output) to see whether keyrefs are resolved or left unresolved at the boundary stage.
If using branch filtering or chunking, verify that the topic remains in the same processing context as the keydef after chunk/merge.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
